columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Detached work must participate in workflow terminal truth
columns.title_zh: Detached Work 必须参与 Workflow 终态真值
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260826-014 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Detached dynamic-node work can remain in flight after static graph completion; awaiting it and propagating failure or interruption prevents the enclosing workflow from reporting success while delegated work actually failed. The mechanism exposes a precise terminal-truth and responsibility boundary for delegated digital work.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260826-014，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Detached Dynamic Node 可能在 Static Graph 完成后仍继续运行；等待这些工作并传播 Failure 或 Interruption，可以防止“委派工作实际失败、所属 Workflow 却报告成功”。该机制形成了数字工作委派中清晰的终态真值与责任边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how detached runs are tracked after static completion, how failure/interruption propagates, whether cancellation and multiple detached nodes preserve ordering, and the regression coverage. Do not generalize this into a claim that every background task model has identical terminal semantics.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Static Completion 后 Detached Run 的跟踪方式、Failure/Interruption 的传播路径、Cancellation 与多个 Detached Node 的顺序语义及回归测试；不得泛化为所有后台任务模型都具有相同终态语义。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: MCP server authority must stay attachment-owned across runtime refresh
columns.title_zh: MCP Server 权限必须在 Runtime Refresh 后继续由 Attachment 所有
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260826-012 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Codex captures a permission profile for each enabled MCP server when publishing the runtime, rejects calls when authority is unavailable, and reuses that server-owned profile for approvals, elicitation and sandbox metadata after refresh. This is a bounded architecture question about authority ownership surviving runtime lifecycle changes.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260826-012，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Codex 在发布 Runtime 时为每个启用的 MCP Server 捕获 Permission Profile，在权限不可用时拒绝调用，并在 Refresh 后继续使用该 Server 所属 Profile 处理审批、Elicitation 与 Sandbox Metadata。该机制形成了“Runtime 生命周期变化后权限所有权如何保持”的明确架构问题。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify where the permission profile is resolved and attached, the unavailable-authority rejection branch, reuse across approval/elicitation/sandbox metadata, refresh replacement rules and tests. Keep conclusions bounded to the demonstrated MCP attachment/runtime contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Permission Profile 的解析与 Attachment 位置、权限不可用时的拒绝分支、Approval/Elicitation/Sandbox Metadata 的复用、Refresh 替换规则及测试；结论须限定于已展示的 MCP Attachment/Runtime 合同。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Per-invocation HTTP options need copy-on-mutation isolation without cloning live clients
columns.title_zh: 每次 Invocation 的 HTTP Option 需要 Copy-on-Mutation 隔离而不复制 Live Client
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260826-016 with Skill 02 score 45/50. ADK replaces unsafe deep copies of RunConfig.http_options with mutation-specific copies: live clients remain shared by reference while mutable containers are copied, preventing callbacks from mutating caller-owned RunConfig and leaking state into later invocations. The mechanism is a concrete engineering boundary between non-copyable live resources and invocation-local mutable state.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260826-016，Skill 02 评分 45/50。ADK 用面向实际修改项的 Copy 替代对 RunConfig.http_options 的不安全 Deep Copy：Live Client 继续按引用共享，而可变容器独立复制，避免 Callback 修改 Caller 所有的 RunConfig 并把状态泄漏到后续 Invocation。该机制明确区分了不可复制的 Live Resource 与 Invocation-local Mutable State。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify which HTTP-option members stay shared, which containers are copied, the callback mutation path, cross-invocation leak regression tests and any nested object exceptions. Do not generalize this into a universal shallow-copy rule.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验哪些 HTTP Option 成员保持共享、哪些容器被复制、Callback Mutation 路径、跨 Invocation 泄漏回归测试以及嵌套对象例外；不得泛化为通用的 Shallow-copy 规则。
